description: Live QA selected a direct reply and reached the decision model, but the cycle failed twice with decision_failed and model_reason 'Cycle did not reach a decision'. Make the decision path return or recover a deterministic terminal result, keep retries idempotent, and prove the reactive event does not remain in a repeatable failure loop. Add regression tests. This issue blocks jido_del-322.7.

comments.text: Fixed in commit 0866db6. Decision-model errors now produce one safe skip with the error reason, finish the selected event as ignored, and do not return a failed cycle to Oban. Regression proof runs the same reactive notification twice: the decision model is called once, the event stays terminal, attempt_count stays 1, and no protocol record is created. Checks: focused 20 tests passed; compile with warnings as errors passed; full package 416 tests passed.

title: Recover a reactive cycle after decision execution returns no decision
